verdict.rationale: telli documents custom tools that let agents reach external information through your APIs, plus system tools like web_search that run during calls, so mid-conversation tool calling is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence covers latency handling, filler speech or avoiding dead air while a tool runs, and the details of custom tools are thin. Missing for 10: evidence of latency masking or filler speech during tool execution, detailed custom-tool docs (request/response schema, timeouts), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Custom tools allow your AI agents to access external information by connecting to your APIs.
enable web_search to let the agent search the web for current public information during calls.
